answer: Rule: every identity must carry a hardware attestation key from a secure enclave, one chip per identity, checked each epoch. A fake costs one $40 device, so 100 fakes cost $4,000 in hardware, and the bill scales linearly with every clone. A grove of agents can share code but never a chip: duplicate keys are rejected at registration and both identities are burned. A karst of cheap virtual machines cannot fake silicon, and the zenith of the defense is simple, no chip, no seat at the table.
